subject: [video] WP07 update: tests now 46/46 (long-field truncation, 128-field cap)
body: Small follow-up to my DONE: I added two runner checks that matter for the phone's JSON validity. (1) a 5000-character field is truncated to exactly 4095 characters, not dropped; (2) a test that writes 200 distinct fields leaves exactly 128 in the JSON object (the parent's cap). Also added: if fork() itself fails (sandbox denying process-fork), probe_run now runs the test in-process with the same record framing in a 1 MiB buffer and reports field nofork=1, instead of losing the test. New result: 'bash gpu/video/probe/test/run_tests.sh' -> 'N2TEST WP07 PASS 46/46' (~10 s). build_ios.sh still links build/ios/n2vt_probe (95200 bytes, 137 imports all covered, LC_MAIN). Nothing else changed; probe/test/STATUS.json and dsh/workers/WP07/STATUS.md are updated.
